items.summary: Maintain a bounded, evidence-only site-factory pipeline. Pipeline: gate03.com—reported readiness brief, strongest recorded candidate, blocked by missing execution owner; therareunicorn.com—reported readiness brief, parked scaffold with analytics not configured; findyourlostpets.com—reported readiness brief with audience, revenue, attribution, compliance, security, and operational fields preserved as unknown. Standard launch packet for each candidate: site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, owner/legal/security/measurement gates, rollback plan, and launch disposition. No deployment, domain change, spend, credential change, telemetry change, monetization change, or public launch is authorized. Exactly one next step: site-factory records the owner disposition for gate03.com’s existing readiness brief and documents whether the missing execution-owner gate remains blocked or is cleared; do not create duplicate work or alter launch state.
